## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D slime-raising, slime-making growth RPG for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Create a mobile/tablet-friendly 3D game where players raise and craft slimes, then adventure with them in an RPG.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save visual-check screenshots as small JPEGs (viewport no wider than 1280px); inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game with Three.js, responsive touch-friendly controls, and localStorage persistence.
- Used a cozy slime habitat, ingredient-mixing lab, turn-based adventures, and slime collection as the core gameplay loop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable game screens and interactions in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added 3D habitat scene, slime raising/crafting, turn-based battles, rewards, collection, and local save state.
- Ran `node --check game.js`; it passed.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected the latest JPEG screenshot at `screenshots/current.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally test the gameplay interactions and phone-sized layout in the browser.
2. Summarize the delivered game and note assumptions when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell and screen containers.
- `styles.css`: Responsive desktop/mobile UI styling.
- `game.js`: Game state, gameplay systems, and Three.js habitat.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: Latest visual check.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- The game runs from a local HTTP server on port 3002.
- Playwright reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404); no game-specific console errors were observed.

content.text:
Built **Slimebound**, a playable, phone- and tablet-friendly 3D slime-raising RPG.

- **Habitat:** Explore a cozy 3D glade and care for your slimes.
- **Slime lab:** Mix ingredients to craft new slime companions.
- **Adventures:** Choose a trail and fight turn-based battles for glow and dew.
- **Collection and progression:** Grow your slimes, discover five slime families, and track your adventures.
- **Save:** Game progress is stored in the browser on your device.

The game is available at `http://localhost:3002`. I checked the game script, tested crafting and battle interactions in the browser, and verified the mobile layout fits a 390px viewport. Three.js is loaded from a CDN, so the 3D habitat needs an internet connection.
